title: 39% checkout abandonment from additional costs
statement:
Late-disclosed fees are a major checkout objection: Baymard reported in 2026 that 39% of surveyed shoppers had abandoned a checkout because of additional costs, supporting upfront full-cost or clearly explained estimated-cost presentation. (Baymard Institute)

Options:
- Upfront total: full-landed-price-on-product-page (fits: transparent, price sensitive, high trust need)
- Itemized cart total: itemized-cart-cost-summary (fits: complex pricing, transparent, comparison shopping)
- Early shipping estimate: shipping-cost-calculator-before-checkout (fits: location dependent, mobile first, risk reducing)
- Explained estimate: estimated-total-with-explanation (fits: variable fees, transparent, service based)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, online retail, marketplaces, subscription checkout. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: How to Reduce Cart Abandonment (Data-Backed UX Strategies)
